title: Fleming 1928 yilda penitsillinni bitta idishda payqagan

scenes.text: 1928 yilda Aleksandr Fleming bakteriya o'stirilgan idishga mog'or tushganini ko'rdi.
Mog'or atrofidagi bakteriyalar yo'qolib ketgan edi.
scenes.keywords: mold growing in petri dish macro

scenes.text: Idishni tashlab yuborish mumkin edi, lekin Fleming nima bo'lganini o'rgandi.
Mog'or ajratgan moddani u penitsillin deb atadi.
1945 yilda Fleming Flori va Cheyn bilan Nobel mukofotini bo'lishdi.
Kutilmagan natijani tashlashdan oldin unga yaxshilab qara.
scenes.keywords: man looking closely at small details

description: 1928 yilda Aleksandr Fleming bakteriya o'stirilgan idishga mog'or tushganini va uning atrofida bakteriyalar yo'qolganini payqadi. Bu penitsillin kashfiyotiga olib keldi; 1945 yilda Fleming Xauard Flori va Ernst Cheyn bilan birga Nobel mukofotini oldi. Sen kutilmagan natijalarga qanday qaraysan?
source: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Alexander Fleming (1928 observation of mould on a staphylococcus plate), https://www.britannica.com/biography/Alexander-Fleming ; The Nobel Prize: Physiology or Medicine 1945 (Fleming, Chain, Florey, 'for the discovery of penicillin and its curative effect'), https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/1945/florey/facts/ ; Britannica: Penicillin, https://www.britannica.com/science/penicillin . Note: Florey and Chain turned penicillin into a usable drug; the prize was shared.
